posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
Well, I can confirm that Sentinels goes down very well with my kids at 6 & 7 as it is, but I would certainly welcome something even more family friendly from >G

I have to explain what many of their cards do but as it's a Co-Op that's just fine. They have a wonderful play style of choosing cards and powers purely on the basis of what they think will be fun, so there's none of the over-arching strategy that I'm used to when playing with adults, but it's still a blast. I haven't given them any of the more complex heroes and I usually play a support role character. My son usually plays Ra although he has tried Tachyon and The Naturalist, and my daughter really only likes to play Unity (she lost interest halfway through a game with Tempest, although we were admittedly facing a brutal loss at the time as well)
